AudioEnhancement.Title: Gestione audio
AudioEnhancement.Intro: Preset di miglioramento audio ispirati a FXSound: a livello di sistema tramite Equalizer APO (se installato) + un visualizzatore dal vivo (WASAPI loopback) nel widget di miglioramento audio.
AudioEnhancement.ApoFound: Equalizer APO rilevato — i preset vengono realmente applicati a tutte le applicazioni.
AudioEnhancement.ApoMissing: Equalizer APO non rilevato — senza di esso i preset migliorano solo il visualizzatore, non la riproduzione reale. Gratuito, open source, sicuro.
AudioEnhancement.PresetsNote: Flat · Bass Boost · Treble Boost · Vocal Boost · Loudness (bassi+acuti insieme, «Loudness» stile FXSound).

Dashboard.Intro: Il tuo desktop, organizzato in un hub di lavoro leggero.
Widgets.Intro: I widget nativi sono leggeri. WebView2 è riservato ai widget HTML/video avanzati.
Widgets.SaveLayout: Salva il layout attuale dei widget
DeskZones.Intro: Zone in stile FancyZones (PowerToys): tieni premuto Maiusc mentre trascini una finestra per vedere le zone dello schermo e rilasciala in una per adattarla automaticamente a quella dimensione.
DeskZones.ShiftDragHint: Senza Maiusc, il trascinamento delle finestre funziona normalmente, senza interferenze. Il layout di ogni schermo si imposta qui, non per singola zona.
DeskZones.ContainersIntro: Trascina file o cartelle in un contenitore per raggrupparli visivamente sul desktop. Premi Spazio (o clic destro → Anteprima rapida) su un'icona per un'anteprima veloce.
DeskContainer.SortingRulesInfo: È supportato un solo criterio di ordinamento alla volta (menu «Ordina per»). Le regole complesse a più livelli (ad es. per tipo di file E poi per nome) non sono ancora disponibili.
Wallpaper.Intro: Un unico motore per sfondi live (playlist video) o procedurali (MotionDesk Waves), con modalità prestazioni e risparmio batteria automatico.
Wallpaper.SupportedFormats: Formati supportati: MP4, M4V, WebM, MOV, OGV, OGG, AVI, MKV, WMV, MPEG, MPG, M2TS, TS. Ciò che non può essere riprodotto (ad es. un codec insolito in AVI/WMV) viene saltato automaticamente passando al successivo.
Wallpaper.PerScreenNote: Uno schermo con un video bloccato non partecipa alla riproduzione casuale/avanzamento della playlist condivisa.
Wallpaper.AudioNote: Vero equalizzatore applicato solo all'audio del video dello sfondo: non influisce sul suono delle altre applicazioni.
Profiles.Intro: Salva l'intera configurazione del desktop e ricaricala con un clic.
Performance.Intro: Panoramica hardware in tempo reale, senza un PerformanceCounter separato per ogni widget.
Automation.Intro: Regole come: quando si avvia un'applicazione → carica un profilo area di lavoro.
About.Body: Questa build usa una vera shell applicativa, mentre gli overlay del desktop restano gestiti in modo indipendente.
About.CapabilitiesList: Widget nativi • aggancio alla griglia • ripristino multi-monitor • layout DeskZone • sfondo animato • visualizzatore audio • profili • automazione • palette comandi • integrazione nell'area di notifica • tasti di scelta rapida globali • modalità prestazioni sensibili alla batteria • tema chiaro/scuro • 14 lingue.

About.InstructionsList:
1. Widget: vai alla pagina «Widget» e scegline uno per farlo comparire sul desktop. Trascina la barra del titolo per spostarlo, ☰ per le opzioni, 🔒/🔓 per bloccarne la posizione, ✕ per chiuderlo.
2. DeskZones: Ctrl+Maiusc+N apre l'editor dei layout delle zone; tieni premuto Maiusc mentre trascini una finestra per agganciarla a una zona.
3. DeskContainer: menu dell'area di notifica → aggiungi un contenitore, poi trascinaci sopra file/cartelle per raggrupparli.
4. Sfondo: vai alla pagina «Sfondo», aggiungi un video e abilitalo. La riproduzione si mette automaticamente in pausa quando un'altra app va a schermo intero.
5. Personalizzazione: la pagina «Personalizzazione» (Ctrl+0) comprende icone, cursori e suoni di sistema.
6. L'icona nell'area di notifica (in basso a destra, accanto all'orologio) dà accesso rapido a profili, sfondo e impostazioni senza aprire la finestra principale.
About.LicenseSummary: Software libero e open source con licenza MIT — libero di usare, modificare e ridistribuire, fornito «così com'è» senza garanzie. Il testo completo della licenza e i componenti di terze parti sono elencati nel file LICENSE nella cartella di installazione.
Common.NoPinnedApps: Nessuna app bloccata — trascinane una sul dock o usa «Blocca applicazione…».
Personalization.Intro: Le parti sicure della visione di personalizzazione, solo tramite registro/API native — nessun file di sistema viene modificato. Tutto ciò che trovi qui è reversibile con i pulsanti Ripristina/Cancella.
Personalization.IconAtlasIntro: Cambia l'icona di Questo PC e del Cestino (vuoto/pieno), oppure imposta un'icona personalizzata per qualsiasi cartella — con lo stesso meccanismo desktop.ini usato da Esplora file.
Personalization.IconPackFolderPrompt: Scegli una cartella con file .ico (ad es. name-empty.ico / name-full.ico)
Personalization.IconPackSingleApplied: Trovato un solo .ico — applicato a Questo PC.
Personalization.IconPackNotFound: Nessun file .ico conforme alla convenzione «-empty»/«-full» trovato in questa cartella.
Personalization.DeskCursorsIntro: Assegna un cursore personalizzato per ogni ruolo. I ruoli non impostati mantengono ciò che Windows usa già — nulla viene sovrascritto a meno che tu non scelga un file.
Personalization.DeskStripIntro: Un dock flottante di app bloccate, in basso al centro dello schermo principale. Trascinaci sopra un file oppure usa «Blocca applicazione…». L'auto-nascondimento non è ancora disponibile — vedi la roadmap.
Personalization.DeskSoundsIntro: Assegna un .wav personalizzato per ogni evento di sistema — lo stesso meccanismo ufficiale del classico selettore delle combinazioni audio di Windows.
Personalization.ThemePackagesIntro: Il formato di pacchetto tema nativo di Windows — raggruppa sfondo, cursori e combinazione audio in un unico file, applicato tramite il gestore temi di Windows. Non è un motore di stili visivi: le forme di finestre/pulsanti non cambiano.
Personalization.LockScreenIntro: Usa lo stesso meccanismo Personalization CSP degli strumenti MDM/Intune. Richiede un prompt di amministratore (scrive un'impostazione a livello di computer) — richiesto ogni volta, solo per questa azione.
Personalization.LockScreenEditionNote: Edizione rilevata: {0}. È documentato che funziona su Pro/Enterprise/Education; su Home Windows potrebbe ignorarlo silenziosamente.
Personalization.LockScreenSuccess: Immagine della schermata di blocco impostata.
Personalization.LockScreenCancelled: Annullato — l'approvazione dell'amministratore è stata rifiutata.
Personalization.LockScreenFailed: Impossibile confermare che la modifica sia stata applicata (forse ignorata da questa edizione di Windows).
Settings.UiSoundCues: Segnali acustici dell'interfaccia (suoni di sistema per le azioni principali)
Settings.WallpaperNote: La playlist video, i temi MotionDesk Waves e le modalità prestazioni si configurano nella pagina Studio sfondi.
Settings.AutoPerformanceMode: Usa automaticamente la modalità sfondo Batteria/Risparmio energia
Settings.StartWallpaperWithApp: Avvia lo sfondo animato con MotionDesk
Settings.ShowSystemMonitorWidget: Mostra il widget Monitor di sistema
WidgetText.NoAudioDevice: Nessun dispositivo di uscita audio rilevato
DCMenu.DefaultContainer: Inserisci per impostazione predefinita tutte le nuove icone in questo contenitore

VersionNotes.1.6.2:
+ FancyWM-style keyboard zone navigation (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrow — plain Ctrl+Alt+Arrow turned out to be already reserved by graphics drivers on many machines): moves the active window to the neighboring DeskZone without a mouse.
~ Real language flag icons (instead of Unicode emoji that rendered as "GR"/"GB").
~ Fixed a real bug where the wallpaper playlist could get stuck after the first transition instead of advancing video by video (race condition in the crossfade between two video layers).
= Confirmed live that automatic .wmv→.mp4 conversion and importing several videos at once work correctly.
~ "About" moved below "Sound Management" in the menu.
~ The Command Palette is now fully translated (it always showed English before, regardless of language).
VersionNotes.1.6.1:
= Performance + translation completion.
+ The "Performance" page gained a GPU meter (load/temperature, the same live hardware sensor as the System Monitor widget) next to CPU/Memory.
= Confirmed that the hitch when opening the System Monitor widget was already fixed (GPU sensors warm up on a background thread).
~ Finished the Greek/English translation of the Widgets, Profiles, Automation, Personalization, Settings and Performance pages — verified live by switching language in both directions.
VersionNotes.1.6.0:
= Stability + DeskZones snap engine.
~ Fixed a crash loop in Audio Enhancement (a leaked Timer after changing page — SetPage now properly disposes the old page).
+ New: a real equalizer (bass/mid/treble/volume) on the wallpaper video's own audio via the Web Audio API — no external tool, other apps' audio is unaffected.
~ Disks widget: the ring is no longer overlapped by the ◀/▶ buttons and the text inside the ring now shrinks automatically to always fit.
~ Partial fix of mixed Greek/English text (tray menu, Control Panel, some dialogs) so they follow the selected language.
~ DeskZones: the whole window-snapping engine was rebuilt — instead of the old unreliable heuristic on a raw mouse hook it now uses the documented Windows signal (SetWinEventHook/EVENT_SYSTEM_MOVESIZESTART) that tells accessibility tools when a window move really started.
~ Fixed a real zone-geometry bug where zones touching a screen edge never reached the actual edge.
~ The zone overlay is now truly translucent (per-pixel alpha layered window instead of an opaque chroma key).
+ New: AquaSnap-style magnetic snap — without Shift, dragging a window near a screen edge/corner previews a half/quarter-screen snap; the full DeskZones grid still requires Shift.
VersionNotes.1.5.0:
= Big pass based on user feedback.
~ DeskZones: fixed a bug where choosing the number of rows/columns in a preset always applied a full grid instead of clean rows/columns; snap-to-zone now stretches windows to the real screen edges (compensating the invisible DWM border).
+ DeskContainers: double-click the title to rename.
+ Widgets: Clock with analog themes (Classic/Neon/Minimal) + digital font/color; Disks rebuilt as one ring per drive with ◀/▶ paging; new "TechGrid" wallpaper style (circuit board, tech theme).
+ Wallpaper: smooth crossfade between videos (no black/white flash), load playlists from .zip/.7z, per-video enable checkbox in the library.
+ New "Sound Management" page (formerly Audio Visualizer): real system-wide audio enhancement through Equalizer APO integration (open source, already signed) when installed — Flat/Bass Boost/Treble Boost/Vocal Boost/Loudness presets plus a live visualizer.
~ The "Help" page was merged into About (duplicate information).
+ Added a "System dependencies" section in Settings (FFmpeg/WebView2 Runtime, installable via winget).
~ The license button now shows the license text in an in-app window (it used to open the Windows "Open with" picker because LICENSE has no extension).
+ Added PE metadata (Company/Copyright/Description) to reduce antivirus false positives.
VersionNotes.1.4.1:
~ SERIOUS fix for the animated wallpaper, especially on Windows 11: on the newer "raised desktop" layout (Progman with WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP, Windows 11 24H2+) the classic 0x052C message that asks Progman to create the sibling WorkerW behind the icons does nothing — it needs wParam=0xD, lParam=1.
= Without it the attach never found a separate WorkerW and always fell back to the Progman path, which explained why the problem persisted.
~ Added explicit detection of this layout and both message variants are now sent.
~ The "SetParent succeeded" check now uses GetAncestor(GA_PARENT) instead of GetParent (GetParent can return the owner instead of the parent for WS_POPUP windows).
~ Bug fix: the "Disks" widget did not fill its own background on each drive row (it showed as a light-gray box in the dark theme) — it now fills UiTheme.Surface like everything else.
= Investigated whether the K-Lite codec pack would help with .wmv: it would not — Chromium/WebView2 uses its own FFmpeg-based media pipeline that never goes through system DirectShow/Media Foundation filters.
= FFmpeg (already used by the conversion service) has its own VC-1/WMV3 decoder — only FFmpeg itself needs to be present.
VersionNotes.1.4.0:
= Big pass based on detailed user feedback.
+ Clock: the time is now truly centered in the widget (both variants), a separate date line under the analog clock, new 12/24-hour format and show/hide seconds options in the ☰ menu.
+ System Monitor: added Network and GPU (load/voltage/temperature, via the open-source LibreHardwareMonitorLib) — text is no longer cut off (Dock=Fill instead of a fixed height).
+ Weather: humidity percentage and Beaufort scale next to wind speed, a larger animated weather icon.
+ New "Disks" widget (usage/capacity of every drive).
+ Audio Visualizer: a second "Winamp" style (gradient bars + reflection) next to "WMP Legacy", selectable from the ☰ menu.
+ Drag & drop of files/folders on ALL widgets (previously only DeskContainers).
+ DeskContainers can now be locked in place (🔒/🔓, like widgets) and are remembered/reopened every session together with widgets.
~ Autostart with Windows now opens in the background (tray icon only, no main window) when widgets/DeskContainers are saved.
~ SERIOUS bug fixed in the live theme-darkness preview: the slider only updated owner-drawn parts live (sidebar/logo), not the main content, until released — now the whole window updates live; SuspendLayout/DoubleBuffered added around full page rebuilds to remove momentary white squares.
+ New "Instructions" and "License" sections in About (previously only shortcuts) — a LICENSE (MIT) file was added.
~ The installer (Inno Setup) now follows the GearWin structure: an "Information" page before installing, a mandatory license page and an update-detected message.
+ Double-click an empty spot on the desktop to hide/restore all icons except This PC / user folder / Control Panel / Recycle Bin (Stardock Fences style) — needs testing on a real desktop.
~ DeskFlip: rebuilt as a real diagonal depth stack with a perspective-warp effect on the windows behind the selected one (a true live 3D render is not possible from public APIs).
+ .wmv is now converted AUTOMATICALLY to .mp4 through FFmpeg (WmvConversionService) before it is added to Wallpaper Studio, instead of a plain warning — if FFmpeg is not found, its download page can be opened right away.
~ DeskContainer ☰ menu rebuilt to match the real Stardock Fences structure.
~ The double-click that hides desktop icons now also hides/restores DeskContainers (except those with "Exclude from quick-hide"), like the real Fences.
+ Icon pack import (depot) for Recycle Bin icons.
+ Wallpaper Waves/Aurora/Particles: width/glow/speed now truly react to the system audio level (fast attack, slow release), not only the separate radial glow overlay that already existed.
VersionNotes.1.3.0:
~ Full pass over the native widgets (Clock/Network/Audio Visualizer/Weather) — no longer just black: a themed, rounded shell that reacts live to theme/darkness changes.
+ Clock: Digital/Analog choice (hand-drawn analog clock) from the ☰ menu.
+ Network: a live download/upload mini-sparkline under the stats.
~ Audio Visualizer: the ASCII text was replaced by a real multi-band equalizer (WASAPI loopback + FFT through NAudio.Dsp, an existing dependency) in WMP Legacy style — segmented LED bars with a slowly falling peak-hold cap.
+ Weather: location picker (☰ menu → "Set location…", geocoding via Open-Meteo), hand-drawn animated weather icons per condition (sun with rotating rays, cloud, falling rain/snow, lightning) and an automatic fallback to a second free provider (wttr.in, no API key) if Open-Meteo fails.
~ SERIOUS bug fixed: the weather URL was built with floating-point numbers without InvariantCulture — in cultures with a decimal comma (e.g. el-GR) 37.9838 became "37,9838", Open-Meteo silently returned a JSON error (not an HTTP error) and the widget showed "Weather unavailable" forever without logging any exception.
VersionNotes.1.2.9:
~ Critical fix for the animated wallpaper (Waves/Particles/Video), borrowed from how Lively Wallpaper does it: the WinForms wallpaper window is always created with the native WS_POPUP style, even with FormBorderStyle.None.
= SetParent to WorkerW/Progman only changed the logical parent — it did NOT convert WS_POPUP to WS_CHILD, so on many Windows 10/11 builds the window did not take part correctly in the new parent's compositing/z-order (staying invisible or acting like a screensaver over the desktop) even when SetParent technically succeeded.
~ An explicit WS_POPUP→WS_CHILD conversion (SetWindowLongPtr + SWP_FRAMECHANGED) is now done before every SetParent.
= Confirmed live that the window now becomes a real child of Progman at the correct screen size.
VersionNotes.1.2.8:
~ UI polish pass: Greek capitals in section/card titles no longer carry accents (correct orthographic convention).
~ All HoverButtons in the app became fully rounded "pills" globally, using the same mechanism (Selectable=false) that fixed the visible focus-rectangle bug on the DeskZones editor's PillButton.
~ The DeskSounds buttons (Browse/Preview/Clear) were clipping text — wider and moved to the right.
~ Bug fix: while the user was on "Lock screen background", the page auto-scrolled back to DeskSounds every 2 seconds — the DeskStrip periodic timer rebuilt its own list inside an auto-scroll container, silently resetting the PAGE's scroll position. Fixed by saving/restoring the scroll position around each refresh.
VersionNotes.1.2.7:
+ DeskZones are now REALLY FancyZones-style (after screenshots of the actual PowerToys editor) — no more permanently visible bordered windows on the desktop.
+ Hold Shift while dragging a window to see the zones and snap (without Shift, dragging is completely normal).
+ New layout editor (Ctrl+Shift+N) with 7 templates (No layout/Focus/Columns/Rows/Grid/Priority Grid/Custom) — adjustable columns/rows ONLY in Custom, the presets keep a fixed shape.
~ A SERIOUS bug was found and fixed before release: a self-referential Click handler caused infinite recursion on every click on a template card — a StackOverflowException, uncatchable in .NET, that terminated the whole app without any exception log.
~ Also fixed a separate bug in the parameter mapping of the "Rows" template (it read the wrong variable for the row count) and a visual bug where the keyboard focus rectangle of a rounded "pill" button stuck out of its rounded outline.
VersionNotes.1.2.6:
~ Bugfix pass after reports: DeskZones "opened by themselves" at startup — caused by a polluted saved "Last Session" profile from internal test runs, now cleaned; the smoke-test script now cleans up its own test zones.
~ Removed the Fences-style roll-up/hover-collapse from DeskZones — their real behavior (snap-on-drop, FancyZones style) was already correct.
~ Fixed a SERIOUS bug where enabling the wallpaper (especially the first time in a fresh session) blocked the UI thread for up to ~8.5 seconds per screen (WorkerW attach retry loop) — the whole app "froze". It now runs on a background thread.
~ The Video Library/Theme & Colors/Wave Tuning sections of the Wallpaper page were ALWAYS visible regardless of the selected Mode — they now appear only when relevant.
~ Fixed a bug where switching Dark→Light "did not respond" (re-entrancy in the theme dropdown popup).
~ Fixed "flicker" on the theme darkness slider — live preview without page rebuild, full application only on release.
~ The version history was cutting text on long entries — cards now take the real height they need.
+ The latest version in the history now stands out with a colored frame.
VersionNotes.1.2.5:
+ New "Dark theme intensity" slider in Settings (0-100%, 50% = the unchanged original base) — live preview while you drag, like the existing Window Opacity.
~ A bug was found and fixed before release: the first implementation made all layers (background/sidebar/cards/hover/borders) converge to identical pure black at 100% — each layer now has its own explicit "floor" color, keeping visual separation across the whole range.
VersionNotes.1.2.4:
+ Completed the "partially feasible" items of the Customization Vision on the Personalization page: .theme packages (a gallery of ready-made Windows themes + saving the current setup as a new .theme, through the OS's own handler) and the lock screen background (Personalization CSP, with elevation only for that single action — never a whole elevated launch of the app).
= The installer was compiled for the first time explicitly on request.
VersionNotes.1.2.3:
+ New "Personalization" page (Ctrl+0) with the safe (registry/native API only) parts of the Customization Vision — all names were checked for trademark conflicts before being chosen: IconAtlas (This PC / Recycle Bin empty-full / per-folder icons), DeskCursors (custom mouse pointer scheme), DeskStrip (floating dock of pinned apps with a live "running now" indicator), DeskSounds (a full system sound scheme beyond the stock cues).
= A visual-style engine and restoring the classic Start Menu/taskbar were considered and explicitly ruled out — both would require patching protected system files.
VersionNotes.1.2.2:
~ Sidebar nav tooltips now always show the keyboard shortcut (e.g. "Widgets (Ctrl+2)"), not just in collapsed mode.
+ New Quick Look preview for DeskContainers — press Space or right-click → Quick Look on a file icon to instantly preview images and text files, or browse a folder's contents, without opening any external app.
VersionNotes.1.2.1:
~ Flip 3D: real keyboard cycling (←/→/Tab/Enter), angled tilted-card layout with the selected window centered.
~ Fixed the sidebar logo showing a stray gray box in compact mode and added a glossy highlight.
~ DeskZones layouts now cover every connected screen, not just the primary one.
+ Wallpaper auto-pauses when another app goes fullscreen.
+ Keyboard shortcuts for every major function (Ctrl+1…9 navigate pages, Ctrl+K palette, Ctrl+B collapse sidebar, Ctrl+E toggle wallpaper, Ctrl+Shift+N new DeskZone — full list in About).
+ Uninstaller now offers to remove saved settings.
~ Installer explicitly declared x64-only.
VersionNotes.1.2.0:
+ DeskZones reworked as FancyZones-style window snapping (drag any window into a zone to fill it); new DeskContainers feature for grouping files/folders/shortcuts on the desktop.
~ Fixed the wallpaper hiding desktop icons when the WorkerW attach silently failed.
~ Custom rounded dropdowns everywhere (replacing classic ComboBoxes) — and fixed a real crash where opening one closed instantly (context-menu disposal bug affecting every popup menu in the app).
+ Collapsible sidebar (icon-only, animated, square tiles).
+ Window opacity setting.
+ Animated wave header background.
+ Sparkline charts for Network/Processes.
~ Nav reorder, bigger logo/title with version number, active-state highlighting on toggle buttons, more icons app-wide.
VersionNotes.1.1.2:
~ Fixed a real crash where creating any DeskZone layout threw a NullReferenceException.
~ Vector icons (no font-glyph dependency) across the sidebar and Widget Gallery.
~ Removed duplicate page titles app-wide.
~ Merged Performance/System Monitor into one tab.
+ Widgets and DeskZones now both show visible ✕ close and ☰ settings-menu buttons instead of relying on right-click.
VersionNotes.1.1.1: ~ Fixed Dashboard sidebar entry being invisible (Home icon added), richer gradient/glow wallpaper wave rendering, Performance page redesigned as a distinct wallpaper-performance control center (no longer duplicates System Monitor's live stats).
VersionNotes.1.1.0: + Theme system (Light/Dark/Follow Windows), localization (EL/EN), colored System Monitor meters, DeskZones/Profiles two-column layouts with layout icons, visible widget Close/Lock buttons, animated sidebar logo, fixed invisible-text rendering bugs (NavButton, StatCard).
VersionNotes.1.0.0: + Initial unified build: Dashboard, Widget Gallery, DeskZones, Wallpaper Studio (video playlist + MotionDesk Waves), System Monitor, Profiles, Performance, Automation, Command Palette, tray integration, global hotkeys.

VersionNotes.1.6.8:
= Major stability and performance audit (includes all intermediate changes 1.6.3–1.6.7).
+ Single instance only: launching the app again focuses the running one.
+ New "Minimize to tray" option in Settings (the ✕ button hides the app to the tray).
+ .wmv→.mp4 conversion now also applies when adding a whole folder.
~ Decorative animations and widgets stop while the window is hidden or a fullscreen app is active.
~ The wallpaper fully suspends when disabled.
~ One shared WASAPI audio capture for all audio features; a shared process cache.
~ Debounced display changes and wallpaper sliders.
~ Memory/GDI leaks fixed (lists rebuilt every 2s, icons, paths, processes).
~ The ✕ button hides the app to the tray instead of destroying it (hotkeys and DeskZones keep working).
~ Hidden desktop icons are restored on exit.
~ Atomic settings saving (no more loss on concurrent reads); "Last Session" is saved before widgets close.
~ Automation applies a profile only when the process starts; loading a profile no longer changes language/theme.
~ Multi-monitor: correct playlist advance, safe magnetic snap at monitor borders.
~ More robust .wmv→.mp4 conversion (no hangs on large files, no corrupt partial files, odd dimensions handled); 7z extraction without freezing.
~ Translations: complete version history and ~100 more strings (widget/container menus, dialogs, file filters, installer) in Greek and English.
~ Security: hardened WebView2 (local pages only, no DevTools/external navigation).
VersionNotes.1.7.5:
= Big feature release: a weather and time-of-day wallpaper, a smarter wallpaper playlist, a redesigned Version History, and many improvements to DeskZones, DeskContainers and Performance.
+ New "Weather" wallpaper mode: a procedural scene that follows the real time of day (sunrise, sunset, moon phase, stars) and the live weather of your location — clouds, high-fidelity rain with ripples and splashes, snow, fog and thunderstorms with lightning. Pick your city, or preview any weather/time manually.
+ Optional raindrops on a window pane (with a refraction effect) while it rains.
+ Weather wallpaper: optional time, date and temperature on screen, with a position, size and °C/°F that you choose (default: centred in the upper third).
+ Wallpaper playlist: video thumbnails and durations, "Select all / none" and a "Remove missing files" button.
+ Wallpaper playlist: play each video N times, or switch to the next video every N minutes.
+ "Include subfolders" option when adding a folder of videos.
+ Wallpaper schedule: switch the wallpaper mode automatically by time of day (up to 3 time windows).
+ Version History redesigned like GearWin: the current release highlighted, a count of additions and improvements for every release, older releases expand on click.
+ Keyboard shortcuts in one tidy card with grouped keycaps — now including the global Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrow zone shortcuts.
+ DeskZones: a list of applications that never snap, and zone numbers in the snap preview.
+ DeskContainers: item count in the title, "Find in container…" and an auto-collect rule that gathers desktop files by type.
+ Performance: CPU/RAM and GPU history graphs, top 5 memory users and an optional notification when CPU or memory stays above 90% for a minute.
+ Update check (once a day, from GitHub releases) and the changelog opens once after an update.
+ Wallpaper attach log (wallpaper-attach.log) to diagnose the intermittent "wallpaper not visible after boot" problem.
+ Every settings file now keeps an automatic .bak copy and is restored from it if it gets damaged.
+ Weather wallpaper: the wind (Beaufort scale) now drives the sea — mirror-calm at Bf 1-2, gentle ripples, choppy water with whitecaps from Bf 5 — and the speed of the clouds; the wind can also be previewed manually.
~ Weather wallpaper: clouds get denser, lower and darker when it rains, with a heavy overcast deck in downpours.
~ Weather wallpaper water redesigned: a soft rippling reflection plus a shimmering sun/moon light path (no mirrored disc, no banding).
~ Shuffle plays every active video once before repeating any (it used to be pure random with repeats).
~ Ticking or removing a video no longer changes the video that is currently playing.
~ The wallpaper status no longer shows "inactive" for a moment when the app opens.
~ RAM usage also shows as a percentage (dashboard, status bar, Performance page, System Monitor widget).
~ The MotionDesk window itself now snaps into DeskZones (it was excluded together with the widgets).
~ DeskContainers: double-click on the title now renames (the native window drag swallowed the double-click); the title is centered in a taller bar with its own accent-tinted background, like Fences.
~ DeskZones layouts follow their monitor when Windows renumbers the displays after a reconnect.

VersionNotes.1.7.6:
= Piccola versione: orologio, data e temperatura ora compaiono su qualsiasi sfondo, compreso il normale sfondo statico di Windows.
+ L'overlay di ora, data e temperatura può comparire sui tuoi video, su Waves e Particles — non solo sulla scena meteo — con le stesse impostazioni di posizione, dimensione e °C/°F.
+ Nuova modalità «Desktop» che mostra il normale sfondo di Windows (immagine statica o presentazione); si avvia da sola quando lo sfondo animato è disattivato e l'overlay è attivo, così orologio, data e temperatura ci sono sempre.
+ Scegli il carattere dell'overlay (caratteri Windows comuni, più «Altri caratteri…» per qualsiasi carattere installato).
+ Nuova sezione «Orologio, data e temperatura» nella pagina Sfondo (tutte le modalità) con posizione, meteo in tempo reale e opzioni dell'overlay in un unico posto.
~ Nelle modalità diverse da Meteo l'overlay mostra l'ora reale e la temperatura in tempo reale (le anteprime di meteo/ora/vento valgono solo per la scena meteo).
~ Il pulsante di ripristino ora si chiama semplicemente «Ripristina posizione» e ripristina solo la posizione.
~ Meno sfarfallii all'avvio: la finestra dello sfondo viene mostrata solo quando il primo fotogramma è pronto (nessun rettangolo nero), le finestre non vengono più ricostruite dopo una notifica dello schermo che non ha cambiato nulla, una ricostruzione mantiene il vecchio sfondo finché il nuovo non è visibile e il blocco dell'orologio non salta più quando arriva la temperatura.
~ Il meteo in tempo reale viene letto senza bloccare (cache + aggiornamento in background con tentativi ripetuti), quindi funziona in modo affidabile anche tramite il bridge WebView2.
VersionNotes.1.7.8:
= Piccola versione: percentuale di RAM ovunque, una barra laterale più fluida e 12 lingue in più.
+ La percentuale di utilizzo della RAM ora compare nella scheda Sistema del dashboard (clicca per i dettagli), nella barra Memoria della pagina Prestazioni, nella barra di stato e nel widget Monitor di sistema.
+ I due grafici cronologici «CPU e RAM» e «GPU» in fondo alla pagina Prestazioni sono stati rimossi.
+ La barra laterale si espande e si comprime in modo fluido: i pulsanti seguono la larghezza fotogramma per fotogramma e il pulsante freccia resta centrato, senza increspature.
+ MotionDesk ora parla le stesse 14 lingue di GearWin: greco, inglese, tedesco, francese, spagnolo, coreano, cinese, italiano, russo, giapponese, portoghese, turco, arabo e hindi (Impostazioni → Lingua). L'orologio e la data dello sfondo seguono la lingua scelta.
+ Personalizzazione: «Importa pacchetto icone» e «Imposta icona cartella» ora sono sulla stessa riga.
Wallpaper.DesktopIntro: Mostra il normale sfondo di Windows (un'immagine statica o la tua presentazione) in modo che ora, data e temperatura possano apparire sopra. Questa modalità si avvia da sola quando lo sfondo animato è disattivato e l'opzione ora/data/temperatura è attiva.
